generalCriterionList.description: Estimate rates are excluding GST as per Common SR 2023-24 CONTINUED FOR 2026-27 and prevailing GST (18% of Amount Put to tender) amount is kept in form of Lump sum in sanctioned estimate according to guidelines in Common SR 2023-24(As per circular from Govt. of Karnataka no.12/2024 Bangaluru Dt:09.08.2024). Therefore, amount put to Tender and ECV amount are excluding GST. KPPP-PORTAL format has No Options to add GST Separately at stage of Draft Tender Schedule Process for Over All amount put to Tender, tender has been inviting through an Option with INCLUSIVE. But the item wise rates do not include GST. Hence, GST will be paid separately for the quoted amount accordingly. Hence the bidder has quote the rate exclusive of GST and to submit a declaration which is duly signed by the bidder along with their tender proposal.
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
The contractor shall submit the details of technical staff employed by him.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public procurement portal
Royalty on construction materials and other applicable taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner.
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incidents happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.

The item rates quoted shall include cost of royalty charges on construction materials and other taxes as per the rates provided in prevailing cost & conveyance of all materials, Curing, Watering, unloading with all leads & lifts Labour, hire charges of machinery equipment etc., complete including all incidental charges. All the items shall beexecuted as directed by the Engineer in charge of the work.
Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the concerned Executive Engineer, PWD Division, during office hours on all working days.
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act.
The Tenderer should furnish all the necessary original documents mentioned above to the Executive engineer
The intending bidders are requested to note that they should abide by the instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender documents KW-1 K.P.W.D. and further orders thereon.
Contractor has to upload the valid EPF registration copy.

The successful bidder has to follow the prevailing Government orders regarding Royalty Charges. The Contractor has to submit MDP Certificate along with the running contractor bills. Otherwise Department will take necessary action as per the Government Orders/Circulars.
Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD.300.LET.2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW.134.BMS.2007 dated 27.07.2007 a sum amounting to 1Percent of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing works and other similar structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost.
Materials like bitumen steel cement etc required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work

The contractor has to quote the same rate to the same items of work that is to be executed at different chainages. If in case, the contractor quotes different rates for the same item appearing at different places of BOQ then, the lowest quoted rate for the same items will be considered for that particular item for evaluation and payment.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
This work is reserved for Scheduled Tribe only
The contractor should up-load Caste Certificate of Scheduled Tribe Compulsory

The Contractor belonging to Scheduled Tribe shall be domicile of the state of Karnataka for more than 10 years He should scan & upload Domicile Residential Certificate for Residing in Karnataka for more than 10 years by the Competent Authority.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: The Tender should be a KPWD Registered Class-IV and above contractorAttach Registration Certificate

Annual Turnover Certificates of last 5 years i.e. period of 2021-22 to 2025-26 Attach Balance sheets & Profit & Loss account statements indicating the contract receipts related to civil engineering construction works duly certified by the chartered accountant.

To qualify for Award of this contract, each Tenderer should have in his name in the last five years, satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least Any Construction work of value not less than Rs. 2.12 lakhs. Attach Work done Certificate issued by competent authority of rank not less than Executive Engineer.
The requisite E.M.D. as prescribed in KPP portal should be submitted by the contractor.
Statement showing the Existing commitments and ongoing works, in the prescribed proformaas per 1.3 A of Section 3 of Qualification information should be furnished.
Statement showing Details of works for which tenders are already submitted in the prescribed proformaas per 1.3 B of Section 3 of Qualification information should be furnished.
This work is reserved for Scheduled Tribe only
The contractor should up-load Caste Certificate of Scheduled Tribe Compulsory.

The Contractor belonging to Scheduled Tribe shall be domicile of the state of Karnataka for more than 10 years He should scan & upload Domicile Residential Certificate for Residing in Karnataka for more than 10 years by the Competent Authority.

itemList.description:
Mechanical Means -
Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means  for all   works   & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical  specifications, including setting out,     shoring,  strutting,  barricading,  caution  lights,     including  dressing  of excavated  surfaces,  disposing  off  or  levelling  the  excavated  earth  or  sorting &   stacking the selected   earth for reuse in a radius of   50 m and lift upto 1.5 m  including  cost  of  labour,  tools,  usage  of  machinery  &  other  appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils  Depth upto 3 m ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials labour HOM of machineries, equipment, lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete, the work shall be carried out as per standard technical detailed specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of the work

Tack coat on Granular surface treated with primer - Providing and applying tack coat with RS1 Bituminous Emulsion using emulsion pressure distributor at the rate of 0.25  kg/m2  on Granular Surface. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 503 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials labour HOM of machineries, equipment, lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete, the work shall be carried out as per standard technical detailed specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of the work

Bituminous Macadam Grading - II for traffic <20 MSA - Providing   and   laying   Bituminous   Macadam   with   100   TPH capacity    hot  mix  plant  batch  type  using  crushed  aggregates of    specified    grading    premixed    with    bituminous    binder VG-30 @ 3.4% by weight of mix, transported to site, laid over a previously  prepared  surface  with  mechanical  paver  finisher  to the required grade, level and alignment and rolled as per clauses 501.6 and 501.7 to achieve the desired compaction. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 504 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials labour HOM of machineries, equipment, lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete, the work shall be carried out as per standard technical detailed specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of the work

Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete - Providing  and  laying  Semi  Dense  Bituminous  Concrete  with 40/60  TPH  capacity   hot  mix  plant  batch  type  using  crushed aggregates of specified grading premixed with bituminous binder VG-30  @  5%  by  weight  of  mix  and  filler,  transported  to  site, laid over a previously prepared surface with mechanical paver finisher to the required grade, level and alignment and rolled as per MoRTH V revision. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - IRC-37:2018 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials labour HOM of machineries, equipment, lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete, the work shall be carried out as per standard technical detailed specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of the work

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete   for all Super structures of building , Road works, Water works, Irrigation works & super structure works of bridges  upto 3.50 m height. The  granite/trap/basalt  crushed graded coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers laid in layers, well compacted using needle   vibrators. The cost  includes  all  lead  &  lifts,   cost  of  all  materials,  quality  confirming  to  the requirements of  relevant IS codes , labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and  all  other  appurtenances  required  to  complete  the  work  as  per  technical specifications. - M 20   Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials labour HOM of machineries, equipment, lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete, the work shall be carried out as per standard technical detailed specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of the work

Steel Fabrication
Supplying,   fitting   and   placing   TMT   FE   550   /   550D   Steel   Reinforcement including  cost  of  all  materials,  machinery,  labour,  cleaning,  straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. All other type of structures ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials labour HOM of machineries, equipment, lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete, the work shall be carried out as per standard technical detailed specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of the work

Applying epoxy mortar over leached, honey combed and spalled concrete  surface  and  exposed  steel  reinforcement  complete  as per Technical Specification. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 2804 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials labour HOM of machineries, equipment, lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete, the work shall be carried out as per standard technical detailed specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of the work

Painting on concrete surface - Providing and applying 2 coats of water based cement paint to unplastered concrete surface after cleaning the surface of dirt, dust, oil, grease, efflorescence and applying paint @ of 1 litre for 2 m2.. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 800 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials labour HOM of machineries, equipment, lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete, the work shall be carried out as per standard technical detailed specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of the work

Providing  and  fixing  on  wall  face  unplasticised  Rigid  PVC  rain  water pipes conforming to IS : 13592 Type A, including jointing with seal ring conforming to IS : 5382, leaving 10 mm gap for thermal expansion, (i) Single socketed pipes 100 mm diameter ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials labour HOM of machineries, equipment, lead and lift, loading and unloading charges, transportation and all other incidental charges etc., complete, the work shall be carried out as per standard technical detailed specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of the work
